properties.title: 520 West 28th completed beside the High Line
properties.short_description: Structurae records 520 West 28th Street, Zaha Hadid Architects' residential building beside the High Line, with completion in 2017.
properties.explanation: An 11-storey condominium building with interlaced levels, terraces, gallery frontage, and residential amenities entered use in West Chelsea.

properties.title: 56 Leonard Street completed in Tribeca
properties.short_description: Herzog & de Meuron records 56 Leonard Street with project and realization dates ending in 2017.
properties.explanation: A 57-storey residential tower with staggered floor plates, terraces, amenities, parking, and ground-level artwork entered the Tribeca skyline.

properties.title: 827-831 Broadway Buildings were designated an individual landmark
properties.short_description: The NYC Landmarks Preservation Commission designation report records the 827-831 Broadway Buildings, LP-2594, as designated on October 31, 2017.
properties.explanation: An official LPC action designated the paired Broadway commercial buildings as an individual landmark.

properties.title: American Copper Buildings welcomed first residents
properties.short_description: Designboom reported SHoP Architects' American Copper Buildings completed and welcoming first residents in April 2017 along the East River waterfront.
properties.explanation: A pair of copper-clad residential towers linked by a skybridge entered residential use beside the East River.

properties.title: A.R.T./New York Theatres opening was recorded
properties.short_description: NYC DDC recorded the official opening of two new A.R.T./New York performance spaces in the lower levels of 502 West 53rd Street in January 2017.
properties.explanation: A documented city design-and-construction press release marked the opening of two flexible theatre spaces and support facilities.

properties.title: Bedford Green House groundbreaking was announced
properties.short_description: NYC HDC announced on November 16, 2017 a groundbreaking milestone for Bedford Green House, a supportive and affordable housing development at 2865 Creston Avenue in the Bronx.
properties.explanation: A documented public housing-finance announcement recorded the start of construction for a supportive and affordable housing building.

properties.title: Billie Holiday Theatre reopened after restoration and expansion
properties.short_description: NYC DDC and DCLA celebrated the reopening of the historic Billie Holiday Theatre in Bedford-Stuyvesant on 9 May 2017 after restoration and expansion.
properties.explanation: A documented cultural venue renovation reopened with new seating, lighting, stage rigging, fire suppression, audio-visual equipment, control room, and stage expansion.

properties.title: Samuel H. and Mary T. Booth House was designated an individual landmark
properties.short_description: The NYC Landmarks Preservation Commission press release records the Samuel H. and Mary T. Booth House at 30 Centre Street as designated an individual landmark on November 28, 2017.
properties.explanation: An official LPC action designated the City Island house as an individual landmark.

properties.title: Brighton Beach Library reopened after renovation
properties.short_description: NYC DDC and Brooklyn Public Library celebrated the reopening of Brighton Beach Library on 13 February 2017 after renovation work.
properties.explanation: A documented public library renovation reopened for community use, adding interior, accessibility, and building-system improvements at the branch.

properties.title: Bronx Children's Museum permanent home broke ground
properties.short_description: NYC DDC reported on 12 July 2017 that construction began on a permanent home for Bronx Children's Museum in Mill Pond Park.
properties.explanation: A documented museum construction milestone began for a second-floor permanent home with studio, office, and exhibit space.

properties.title: Brookfield Park opened after landfill-to-park transformation
properties.short_description: NYC DEP and NYC Parks recorded the official opening of Brookfield Park on Staten Island after remediation, capping, transfer to Parks, wetland restoration, and trail creation.
properties.explanation: A former municipal solid-waste landfill entered documented public park use with meadows, wetlands, woodlands, marshes, streams, ponds, and walking trails.

properties.title: Brooklyn Bridge Park Pier 5 Uplands opened
properties.short_description: Brooklyn Bridge Park's official press release records the opening of the Pier 5 Uplands on July 6, 2017.
properties.explanation: A documented opening or public-use milestone was recorded for the named facility.

properties.title: Brooklyn Navy Yard Building 77 reopened after renovation
properties.short_description: CityLand records that Mayor de Blasio opened Building 77 at the Brooklyn Navy Yard after a major renovation.
properties.explanation: A former Navy Yard storage building re-entered use as a manufacturing, food, and office hub.

properties.title: New City Island Bridge opened to motorists, cyclists, and pedestrians
properties.short_description: Borough President Diaz Celebrates Opening of New City Island Bridge in The Bronx records "New City Island Bridge opened to motorists, cyclists, and pedestrians" with source date 2017-10-29.
properties.explanation: A documented official borough president release recorded vehicular, bicycle, and pedestrian bridge replacement.

properties.title: Columbia School of Nursing building officially opened
properties.short_description: Columbia University Irving Medical Center Facilities records that the seven-story School of Nursing building officially opened in August 2017, with clinical teaching, research, and student spaces.
properties.explanation: A medical education building entered use at Columbia's Washington Heights medical campus.

properties.title: Cornell Tech Roosevelt Island campus opened
properties.short_description: Cornell Tech celebrated the official opening of the first phase of its Roosevelt Island campus.
properties.explanation: A new applied-science campus and public open-space framework entered use on Roosevelt Island.

properties.title: Corona Plaza capital construction broke ground
properties.short_description: NYC DOT and DDC marked the groundbreaking of capital construction for the redesigned Corona Plaza on 10 April 2017.
properties.explanation: A documented construction phase began to permanently establish Corona Plaza with lighting, wayfinding, furniture, bike racks, public toilet, and performance power.

properties.title: Dancewave studios broke ground in Gowanus
properties.short_description: NYC DDC reported on 3 August 2017 that DDC and DCLA broke ground on new Dancewave studios at 182 Fourth Avenue.
properties.explanation: A documented cultural-facility construction milestone began for new dance studios and performance-capable space.

properties.title: Peter P. and Rosa M. Huberty House was designated an individual landmark

properties.title: Hudson Theatre reopened as a Broadway venue
properties.short_description: The Hudson Theatre official past-productions page records Sunday in the Park with George beginning on February 11, 2017 and identifies it as the production that opened Broadway's new Hudson Theatre.
properties.explanation: A restored landmark theater at 141 West 44th Street returned to documented Broadway performance use.

properties.title: IRT Powerhouse was designated an individual landmark
properties.short_description: LPC Designates IRT Powerhouse as an Individual Landmark records "IRT Powerhouse was designated an individual landmark" with source date 2017-12-05.
properties.explanation: A documented official LPC designation press release recorded infrastructure landmark designation.

properties.title: Jerome L. Greene Science Center opened at Columbia Manhattanville
properties.short_description: Columbia University project materials record the Jerome L. Greene Science Center, Lenfest Center for the Arts, and The Plaza opening in May 2017 as part of the Manhattanville campus.
properties.explanation: A major university neuroscience building with public ground-floor uses entered use on the Manhattanville campus.

properties.title: Kew Gardens Hills Library reopened after expansion
properties.short_description: Queens Public Library recorded the reopened Kew Gardens Hills Library in September 2017 after a major expansion and renovation.
properties.explanation: A Queens branch library returned to public use with expanded space, new public areas, and upgraded facilities.

properties.title: Kosciuszko Bridge first replacement span opened
properties.short_description: New York State DOT recorded the grand opening of the first new Kosciuszko Bridge span on 27 April 2017, with traffic opening late that evening.
properties.explanation: A new cable-stayed bridge span entered traffic use between Queens and Brooklyn over Newtown Creek.
